_doc: LAYOUT_LILYCOVE_CITY_DEPARTMENT_STORE_ROOFTOP (18x12; rows 7-11 are the store's facade below the roof, not walkable): the roof floor (1-16, 1-6) with the stairwell house (12-14, 1-3) and its door (13,3) down to 5F, the raised roof (15-17, 1-2); two vending machines (9-10, 1); planters (1-2, 3) and (1-2, 5); benches (5-6, 5) and (9-10, 5); chairs (16, 4-5) facing west. Style "shop_roof": grey roof tiles chip_yuka (texture set 326) and the sky with clouds in39_sora (texture set 320) as the walls around the roof (Sapphire shows railings and sky); vending machines in_vender01, door cabin_door, planters plant01, benches and chairs chair01 (Black 2 puts chairs on solid tiles, as these are).

furniture._what: vending machine (9,1): Black 2 tile attribute 0xE2 = its own vending machine (Fresh Water / Soda Pop / Lemonade, Sapphire's three drinks)
